name: St. Regis La Bahia Blanca Resort, Tamuda Bay
insider_take: This Mediterranean-style sanctuary sits where the Rif Mountains meet the crystal-clear waters of Tamuda Bay, offering an exclusive slice of Morocco's untouched northern coast.
whats_special: St. Regis La Bahia Blanca is Morocco's first St. Regis property, featuring the brand's signature butler service alongside traditional Moroccan hospitality. The resort boasts direct access to one of the Mediterranean's most pristine beaches, while the nearby UNESCO World Heritage city of Tetouan offers authentic Andalusian-Moorish architecture just 15 minutes away.
pro_tip: Book a sunset sailing excursion from the resort's private marina - the views of the Rif Mountains reflected in Tamuda Bay are absolutely spectacular and far less crowded than other Mediterranean destinations.
dont_miss: The evening St. Regis ritual with champagne sabering at sunset, and a day trip to the blue-painted mountain town of Chefchaouen (90 minutes away) - one of Morocco's most photogenic destinations nestled in the Rif Mountains.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Tamuda Bay
Luxurious St. Regis signature butler service and amenities
Authentic Moroccan architecture and design elements
Access to exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits
cons: Remote location may require longer transfers from airports
